name: Hilton Honors American Express Aspire Card

loungeAccess.network: Priority Pass Select (1,300+ airport lounges worldwide)
loungeAccess.notes: Complimentary Priority Pass Select membership with enrollment required. Includes 2 complimentary guest passes per lounge visit. Does not include Amex Centurion Lounge access.

tripDelay.notes: Up to $500 per covered trip for delays of 6+ hours. Maximum 2 claims per 12-month period.

tripCancellation.notes: Maximum $10,000 per covered trip, $20,000 per eligible card account per 12 consecutive months.

lostBaggage.notes: High-risk items (jewelry, electronics) capped at $1,000 per person per trip.

emergencyMedical.notes: Premium Global Assist Hotline: 24/7 emergency assistance coordination including medical evacuation transport (Amex covers transport costs). Does not cover medical treatment costs.

rentalCarInsurance.countries: Worldwide except Australia, Italy, New Zealand, and OFAC-sanctioned countries.
rentalCarInsurance.notes: Secondary car rental coverage. Must decline rental company's CDW/LDW. Up to 30 consecutive days.

airlineCredit.notes: Up to $250 in statement credits per year for eligible airline incidental fee purchases (baggage fees, seat upgrades, in-flight purchases) — NOT airfare itself.

hotelCredit.notes: Two $100 Hilton resort credits semi-annually ($200 total per year). Valid at Hilton Resort properties within the US and Puerto Rico. Applicable to room charges, spa, dining, and recreational activities at eligible resorts.

otherCredits.name: Free Night Reward
otherCredits.notes: One complimentary Weekend Night Reward each year automatically upon card renewal. Additionally, earn a second free night reward after spending $60,000 on the card in a calendar year.

rewards.travelRate: 14x at hotels and resorts in the Hilton portfolio

otherBonusCategories.category: Qualifying flights booked directly with airlines or amextravel.com

pointValue.transferPartners: 0.4–0.6¢ per Hilton Honors point; best redeemed for luxury Hilton stays

travelPerks: Complimentary Hilton Honors Diamond status (top tier — no spending requirement)
Annual free weekend night reward upon card renewal
Up to $250/year in airline incidental fee credits
Up to $200/year in Hilton Resort credits ($100 semi-annually)
Priority Pass Select airport lounge access with 2 guest passes
Premium Global Assist — emergency evacuation transport covered by Amex
14x Hilton Honors points on Hilton hotel stays
7x points at US restaurants, supermarkets, and gas stations
$100 Global Entry/TSA PreCheck credit every 4 years
Secondary rental car insurance up to $75,000
bestFor: Hilton elite travelers who want top-tier Diamond status and can maximize the airline credit, resort credits, and free night award to easily offset the $550 annual fee
